summary: Iter 12 frontend-only verification of Products page display fix. Loaded /products (2,487 rows). Confirmed the '—' problem is gone: every row renders numeric values in all 9 required columns (Units, Orders, Revenue, COGS, Op, Ship, Comm, Margin €, Margin %). 1,399 has_cost=false rows show '€0⚠' in COGS while still showing non-empty Op/Ship/Comm/Margin €/Margin %. 1,088 has_cost=true rows show actual COGS with no ⚠. Margin € color is rgb(0,168,89) green when >=0 and rgb(255,42,42) red when <0. Margin % color is rgb(94,99,110) grey when >=0 and rgb(255,42,42) red when <0. Sort by Margin % ascending (2 clicks on [data-testid='sort-margin_pct']) puts most-negative at top (AMB-raclette -1822.6%, col-lam-danger-D20 -279.7%, ...). SKU-starts-with filter (AMB-) works (2487->26). Stock items toggle works (2487->157). Export Excel button [data-testid='products-export'] present and clickable. No dashes found anywhere in the 9 numeric columns.
critical_code_review_comments: Products.jsx renders 2,487 rows unvirtualised in a single table which is a scroll performance risk on lower-end machines; consider react-window or pagination when catalog grows.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Products page display fix verified. All numeric cells populated. ⚠ marker present only on has_cost=false rows next to €0 COGS. Colors, sorting by margin_pct, SKU-starts-with filter, Stock-items toggle, and Export button all functional. Backend not retested (unchanged per iter 10 verification).
rca of the issue: Not applicable - display fix confirmed working.
